```{=html}
<header class="page-header"><div class="page-shell">
<p class="eyebrow">Tool · Field epidemiology</p>
<h1>STEPS FETP Scale-up Decision Aid</h1>
<p>Scalable Training Estimation and Planning System for Field Epidemiology Training Programmes in India.</p>
</div></header>
<section class="content-section"><div class="page-shell narrow">
<div class="tool-facts">
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Problem</h2><p>Planning FETP scale-up requires balancing programme design, cost, expected endorsement, and indicative health benefit under resource constraints.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Users</h2><p>Policymakers and partners planning FETP scale-up in India, developed through work at The University of Newcastle with the World Bank.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Inputs</h2><ul class="cv-list"><li>Programme tier, career incentive, mentorship intensity, delivery mode, response time, cost per trainee, cohort size, and number of cohorts.</li><li>Planning assumptions including completion rate, horizon, and exchange-rate display settings.</li></ul></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Outputs</h2><ul class="cv-list"><li>Predicted endorsement of a configuration versus opting out.</li><li>Perceived programme value per trainee and cohort.</li><li>Programme, mentor-support, and opportunity costs.</li><li>Scenario comparison and national-scale simulation.</li></ul></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Evidence base</h2><p>Preference outputs are generated from a mixed-logit model estimated from a discrete choice experiment. Cost calculations combine harmonised templates; indicative health benefits use transparent epidemiological multipliers.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Limitations</h2><p>Outputs are indicative and depend on assumptions supplied. The tool is intended to support planning and discussion rather than replace detailed appraisal.</p></div>
</div>
<p class="tool-notice"><strong>Application availability.</strong> The deployable standalone application files are not currently present in this GitHub repository, so this page intentionally does not expose a broken launch link.</p>
<p class="inline-links"><a href="/research/projects/fetp-india/">FETP India project</a><a href="/research/projects/decision-support-tools/">Decision-support research</a></p>
</div></section>
```
